title: Man's secret use of synthetic testosterone for cows nearly destroyed his heart
gist: NEJM case report on a Massachusetts man whose 11 years of recurrent heart failure and multi-organ problems were ultimately traced to undisclosed anabolic-androgenic steroid use, including the veterinary drug trenbolone. Doctors warn AAS-related cardiomyopathy and hypogonadism cases will grow as US AAS use reaches an estimated 2.9-4 million people.

insights.so_what: Illustrates how hidden AAS use drives repeated costly hospitalizations and specialist workups.
